svg.aria-label: THERMA concentrator on its bayonet interface, section on the axis plane: an outer shell of 2.6 mm nominal wall and an internal duct of 2.0 mm nominal wall, separated by an empty void; the two come closest, 0.23 mm apart, at the duct's front edge (detail A). The air path runs from a Ø28 mm inlet through the interface to a 26.0 × 6.0 mm outlet slot in a shroud with a 1.55 mm minimum wall; Ø47 mm collar; 82 mm from the collar face to the outlet. Section B–B shows shell, void and duct as concentric rounded rectangles. Model dimensions of a design study, not measured on a part; the void is geometry only and no thermal or airflow performance is claimed.
